reason.pt: Creme inglês/custard coagula mal fora de 80–84 °C (nappe a 82–84 °C; talha acima).
reason.en: Custard sets wrong outside 80–84 °C (nappe at 82–84 °C; curdles above). Research 04.

reason.pt: Acima de 18 °C a manteiga funde durante a laminagem e as camadas perdem-se.
reason.en: Above 18 °C butter melts during lamination and layers are lost. Research 04.
